verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Unleash's own SDKs ('over 30 SDKs', '15 official client and server SDKs') and code such as unleash.isEnabled(...), but never mentions OpenFeature or OpenFeature providers. Vendor-neutral flag APIs are a fair question for a feature-flag platform, so the axis applies. Native SDK breadth is an adjacent feature and does not deliver vendor-neutral flag code.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can use the vendor through OpenFeature providers so my flag code isn't locked to one vendor's SDK API
